answer.rationale: Competitor price cut has doubled churn conversations in SMB base, requiring immediate tactical response. Memory 73 confirms targeted promotional pricing is effective for price-sensitive SMB segments with strong acquisition and revenue lift. Memory 31 shows signup simplification has durable SMB benefit. A standard-scale promotional pricing test targets the immediate threat while preserving ability to layer onboarding simplification (memory 86: +3% retention, +13% completion) as a retention backstop. This combination addresses both acquisition defense and activation durability. Enterprise sales assist (memory 44) is orthogonal to SMB price sensitivity. Referral incentives (memory 57) work best on established customers, not useful for churn defense. Activation messaging alone (memory 91) does not directly counter price-driven defection. Promotional pricing carries revenue-per-account risk if not time-bounded, but a controlled experiment preserves the option to layer other levers. Standard experiment scale allows rapid iteration without broad brand signal while verification budget is exhausted.
